run_flownet2_training: run the FlowNet2 optical flow model training loop with configurable datasets, loss, and optimizer via CLI
run_flownet2_inference: run optical flow inference on a dataset and optionally save predicted flow fields as .flo files
run_flownet2_validation: run validation of the FlowNet2 model every N epochs with TensorBoard logging and checkpoint saving
run_flownet2_fp16_training: run the FlowNet2 training loop in pseudo-fp16 mixed-precision mode with configurable loss scaling
resume_flownet2_training: resume FlowNet2 training from a saved checkpoint file using the --resume CLI argument
